records.failureSummary: Implemented and verified escapeHtmlText, escapeAttrUrl, and parseInlineLinks in src/render.mjs only. escapeHtmlText escapes & first, then < > and both quotes (" -> ", ' -> '), producing & < > " ' and not re-escaping the entities it generates. escapeAttrUrl escapes only & " ' (ampersand, double quote, single quote) and leaves < and > untouched, for use inside double-quoted href values. parseInlineLinks scans a text node for [text](url) occurrences using a non-nested pattern, escapes surrounding non-link text with escapeHtmlText, renders each match as text with the link text escaped via escapeHtmlText and the url attribute-escaped via escapeAttrUrl, supports multiple links per line in input order, and leaves malformed or nested-bracket input untouched after text escaping. No new dependencies were added; src/frontmatter.mjs and the renderPage stub were left unchanged to preserve the API contract. Build (node --check) and lint both pass; the repo-wide test suite's remaining failures are the out-of-scope renderPage/buildSite stubs owned by other tasks.
